name: pRFs / Benson14-Retinotopy
summary: Predicts retinotopic maps (polar angle, eccentricity, pRF size) and visual area labels V1-V3a from a FreeSurfer subject with the Benson 2014 anatomical template in neuropythy.
description: Runs neuropythy benson14_retinotopy on a FreeSurfer recon-all directory and reorganises the results into pRF maps (volume and surface), a 12-region visual area parcellation (V1, V2, V3, hV4, VO1, VO2, LO1, LO2, TO1, TO2, V3b, V3a) in volume and on the surface, and GIfTI surfaces. Use it to obtain visual cortex ROIs and retinotopy without functional mapping data. Needs a FreeSurfer license.

outputs.description: Predicted pRF maps: polar angle, eccentricity, receptive field size and visual area, as volumes and surface overlays.
